DELIBERATELY EMPTY - every functional clause of 'Whenever an arrow is put face up into your arsenal from your deck, you may pay {r}. If you do, put an aim counter on it' depends on DSL/engine machinery verified absent this session. Authoring the ability anyway would look implemented and be inert (or worse, misfire once partial fixes land), so the target shape is recorded here instead.

THREE VERIFIED GAPS:
1. DISPATCH REACH: ON_PUT_FACEUP_IN_ARSENAL is emitted exactly once (state.py Zone.add, :322-328), slug-keyed to the MOVED card - dispatch() (dsl/__init__.py:9-51) then fires abilities of THAT slug only. Crow's Nest is a third-party watcher (equipment), so it never receives the event. Needs a fan-out listener to the controller's equipment/permanents, the pattern ON_TRAP_TRIGGER already uses (interpreter.py:100-110).
2. EVENT-CARD CONDITIONS: ability-level conditions bind to the SOURCE card (interpreter.run_ability passes Crow's Nest), so CARD_SUBTYPE_IN ['Arrow'] would ask whether Crow's Nest is an arrow. No condition tests the event's card or its owner ('an ARROW', 'YOUR arsenal'); the only payload readers are player-oriented (EVENT_PLAYER, WAGER_WINNER).
3. EVENT-CARD REF + AMOUNT: nothing populates a ref with the moved card, so PUT_COUNTER_REF (effect_types.py:3473-3488, reads ref/counter_type/amount) finds no target and returns silently. Note also its amount is used raw in range(_a) - it does NOT resolve {'type': 'PAID_AMOUNT'} dicts, so the pay-gate cannot be emulated by amount-scaling the way Crowd Control's family might.

TARGET SHAPE once the gaps close (for whoever implements them):
  {"ability_type": "STATIC_TRIGGERED", "trigger": "ON_PUT_FACEUP_IN_ARSENAL",
   "effects": [{"type": "MAY_PAY_UP_TO", "max": 1},
               {"type": "PUT_COUNTER_REF", "ref": "<event card>", "counter_type": "aim", "amount": 1}]}
MAY_PAY_UP_TO max 1 (effect_types.py:1468-1499) is the faithful 'you may pay {r}': asks 0..1 capped by resources, charges via canonical lose(), publishes state._paid_amount. Binary 'if you do' then needs either a PAID_AMOUNT_GTE-style condition (none exists - grepped condition_types.py this session) or the ref-gated form above.

TRIGGER CHOICE: ON_PUT_FACEUP_IN_ARSENAL over ON_PUT_FACEUP_FROM_DECK - the latter demands prev_zone=='deck' AND source=='effect' AND any non-deck destination (state.py:330-336; built for Back Alley Breakline), so it would miss rule-sourced arsenal loads; the former has the right destination but ignores 'from your deck' (would also count hand->arsenal effect moves). Neither is exact; flagged rather than chosen silently.

RELEASE NOTES, already satisfied by Zone.add: a card TURNED face-up in arsenal does not re-fire (the event lives in Zone.add, which flipping-in-place never calls); multiple triggers stack aim counters (PUT_COUNTER_REF loops per counter) - 'two counters, not twice the effects' is downstream consumers' business.

NOT AUTHORED: Specialization is a printed keyword (printed_keywords) - it fires from the card DB keywords field; re-authoring it would be a defect.
